src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Providers/D.name: Database retry limits
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Providers/D.description: Holds the settings for how long and how often the app retries when the database drops a connection or switches servers.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Providers/I.name: Database setup contract
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Providers/I.description: Describes what any database setup must provide: how to connect and where its changes are kept.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Providers/P.name: Database address checker
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Providers/P.description: Tidies the database connection details and, in live use, requires an encrypted connection.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Providers/P.name: Postgres database setup
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Providers/P.description: Connects the app to Postgres with the retry limits applied.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Providers/Q.name: Risky search alarms
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Providers/Q.description: Turns risky database searches into errors when a setting asks for it, so mistakes show up during testing.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.name: Request limit rule
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.description: Sets how many times one visitor address may try things like signing in within a time window, with the count shared between servers.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.name: Per-visitor request counter
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.description: Counts each visitor address's requests in a time window using the shared counter, and refuses those over the limit.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.name: Report load cap
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.description: Limits how many reports one farm can run at the same time, counted across all servers.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.name: Failed sign-in counter
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.description: Counts refused sign-in attempts per visitor address, shared between servers, so repeated failures can be cut off.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.name: Visitor address key
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.description: Works out which visitor address a request counts against for request limits.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.name: Report cap setup
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.description: Switches on the report load cap at startup, using Redis when available and in-memory counting otherwise.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.name: Report slot
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/RateLimitin.description: Represents one held place in the report load cap and keeps renewing it until the report finishes.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: One-time claim contract
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Describes a store where something can be claimed only once within a time limit, used to stop a pass being reused.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: Time-window counter contract
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Describes a counter that adds up within a fixed time window, used by the request limits.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: Reserved slot contract
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Describes a time-limited reservation that can be renewed and released, used by the report load cap.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: One-time claims in memory
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Keeps one-time claims in the server's own memory, for a farm running a single server without Redis.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: Counter in memory
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Keeps time-window counts in the server's own memory, for a farm running a single server without Redis.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: Reserved slots in memory
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Keeps report slot reservations in the server's own memory, for a farm running a single server without Redis.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: One-time claims in Redis
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Keeps one-time claims in Redis so all servers see them.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: Counter in Redis
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Keeps time-window counts in Redis so all servers share one count.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: Reserved slots in Redis
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Keeps report slot reservations in Redis so all servers share them.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: Safe one-time claims
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Wraps the one-time claim store so it keeps working if Redis becomes unavailable.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: Safe window counter
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Wraps the time-window counter so it keeps working if Redis becomes unavailable.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.name: Shared counters setup
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/SharedState.description: Chooses at startup between Redis and in-memory versions of the one-time claims, counters and reserved slots.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Time/FarmCl.name: Farm clock
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Time/FarmCl.description: Works out the farm's current date and day boundaries in its own time zone, so stock and allocation checks in one request agree.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Time/System.name: System clock
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Time/System.description: Provides the current time to the rest of the app.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Time/TimeZo.name: Time zone check
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Time/TimeZo.description: Checks at startup that the server knows the time zones the farm clock needs.
